Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for a great discovery today. Quick recap and the next actions I promised:

- Primary goal: productionize LLM-powered clinical triage assistant with predictable latency and auditable logs.
- Constraints: must support PHI, integrate with existing KMS (Azure Key Vault), and retain auditable request/response logs for 7 years.
- Attendees you want on the deep-dive: 1x ML engineer, 1x Platform/SRE, 1x Security/compliance lead.

Can you confirm the attendee list and whether any of the following are blockers we should pre-read?
- Any vendor onboarding docs for Azure Key Vault + Crestline network topology
- Any additional compliance artifacts beyond SOC 2 (e.g., HITRUST)

Suggested slots (Pacific):
- Tue Oct 12, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Tue Oct 12, 14:00–15:30 PT
- Wed Oct 13, 09:00–10:30 PT

If none of these work, tell me two times that do and I will lock. I’ll drop a calendar invite once we confirm.

Attachments: proposed-agenda.pdf (PDF) — draft agenda and attendee roles; crestline-ops-constraints.xlsx — a short template to capture network/KMS details if you want to drop specifics before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
